description: Talks to Marsell, the project's marketer, in its chat: ask what it is doing and why, or tell it what to change (the week, a post, the plan). Returns Marsell's reply, what it changed, the conversation's id, anything that waits for the owner's press, and each card it raised for the owner (a picture's ad, which spends only when the owner starts it) with its id and words. Prefer the direct tools for a plain read or change; use this for what needs Marsell's judgement or works on a canvas or a video. Marsell uses its own tools, so an answer may take a minute and spends the owner's tokens. With canvas or video, Marsell works on that canvas or video as when the owner has it open: what spends or posts there waits for the owner's press in Marsell's chat, and the answer says so. With attachments, the files sent through get_upload_link (each answer's attachment ids) go with the message, as files sent in the chat do.

attachments.description: Files to send with the message, by the attachment ids an upload link's answer gave (get_upload_link, kind file).

part.description: The part picked on it, when one is.

conversation.description: Continue this conversation (the id an earlier answer gave).

message.description: What you say to Marsell, in plain words, as the owner would.

new_conversation.description: Start a fresh conversation instead of continuing the latest.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

video.description: A video, by its channel and episode ids (canvas_film's answer gives them as open).

at.description: The second of the film being talked about.
